{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
A manuscript must meet minimum length requirements of exactly 22 pages or more to pass R1. For format, either the official template applies or documented revision history spanning 3 years is required, unless Track D submission occurs where exactly 2 endorsements substitute the revision requirement instead. Note that Track D exemption applies only to this specific rule regarding revisions. Venue restrictions hinge on presentations occurring strictly more than 18 months before the deadline; exactly 18 months fails the condition completely. Prior acceptances bar submissions if 5 years have not yet elapsed since that round, though exactly 5 years remains acceptable. A withdrawal does not count as acceptance for prior rounds but resets the venue clock to the withdrawal date itself. Retracted manuscripts with open notices are never handled, overriding all other considerations including figure adjustments entirely. Paired submissions require precisely 2 manuscripts, both satisfying length and format independently, though only one needs to meet the venue restriction condition. Figure counts must fall between 8 and 45 inclusive for single entries, extending to 70 for pairs with the same lower bound applied. Submissions exceeding maximums return immediately, while those below minimums receive a padded verdict unless another rule fails, in which case they return outright. Track D exclusions do not extend beyond rule R2, preserving all other constraints for those manuscripts.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":1785109342,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
